----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This scipt if for gathering information from NOAA's Global Historical Climatology Network daily (GHCNd) land surface stations around the globe. It rasterizes the points from 2010-2024
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


```{r}
#Librariers needed
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(data.table)
```



```{r}
# Download and read station metadata
station_url <- "https://www1.ncdc.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/ghcnd-stations.txt"

#reads station text files and creates a dataframe with station ids
stations <- read_fwf(station_url, fwf_cols(
  station_id = c(1, 11),
  latitude = c(13, 20),
  longitude = c(22, 30),
  elevation = c(32, 37),
  state = c(39, 40),
  name = c(42, 71),
  gsn_flag = c(73, 75),
  hcn_flag = c(77, 79),
  wmo_id = c(81, 85)
))
```


```{r}
#collects a general dataframe with dates of the stations start year and end year
inv_url <- "https://www1.ncdc.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/ghcnd-inventory.txt"

inventory <- read_fwf(inv_url, fwf_cols(
  station_id = c(1, 11),
  latitude = c(13, 20),
  longitude = c(22, 30),
  element = c(31, 35),
  first_year = c(37, 40),
  last_year = c(42, 45)
))
#filter for years 2010 to 2024
filtered <- inventory %>%
  filter(last_year >= 2010 & first_year <= 2024) %>%
  select(-element) %>% # this has TMIN and different measurements at each station. Could keep if want this. 
  distinct(station_id, .keep_all = TRUE) # Keep only unique station ids

# Join with station metadata for coordinates
stations_filtered <- left_join(filtered, stations, by = c("station_id", "longitude", "latitude"))

# Convert to sf points
sf_points <- st_as_sf(stations_filtered, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)


```


```{r}
#This section opens up each individual dly station file (of 77,355) and checks which years they were active between 2010 to 2024.

# Setup parallel processing
plan(multisession, workers = 4) 

# Years of interest
years_to_check <- 2010:2024

# Function to check which years are active for a given station_id
get_active_years_from_ghcn <- function(station_id) {
  tryCatch({
    url <- sprintf("https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/all/%s.dly", station_id)

    # Read only header lines (first 21 characters include year and month info)
    raw_lines <- read_lines(url, progress = FALSE)
    
    if (length(raw_lines) == 0) {
      warning(paste("Empty or unreadable file for station:", station_id))
      return(rep(FALSE, length(years_to_check)))
    }

    # Extract years from fixed-width format
    years <- str_sub(raw_lines, 12, 15) |> as.integer()
    years <- years[!is.na(years)]

    # Check which years are present
    active_flags <- years_to_check %in% years

    message(paste0("Station: ", station_id, " | Years found: ", paste(unique(years), collapse = ", ")))

    return(active_flags)

  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error with station:", station_id, "->", e$message))
    return(rep(FALSE, length(years_to_check)))
  })
}

# Split into chunks if memory becomes a problem
stations_split <- split(stations_filtered, (seq_len(nrow(stations_filtered)) - 1) %/% 100)

# Process each chunk
results_list <- map(stations_split, function(chunk_df) {
  future_map(chunk_df$station_id, get_active_years_from_ghcn, .progress = TRUE)
})

# Combine results back into a full matrix
active_year_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_list, function(x) do.call(rbind, x)))

# Bind the results back to the original dataframe
colnames(active_year_matrix) <- as.character(years_to_check)

stations_with_year_flags <- bind_cols(
  stations_filtered,
  as_tibble(active_year_matrix)
)

# write_csv(stations_with_year_flags, "stations_with_active_years.csv")


```

```{r}

crs_moll <- st_crs("ESRI:54009")$wkt


weather_complete <- station_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude) , !is.na(longitude) , !is.na(station_id),
  # filter out profiles with incorrect longitude and latitudes
  longitude >= (-180) & longitude <= 180,  
  latitude >= (-90) & latitude <= 90)

weather_stations_sf <- st_as_sf(weather_complete, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

plot(weather_stations_sf[,1])
#make a version in mollweide for better processing
weather_sts_moll_sf <- st_transform(weather_stations_sf, crs_moll)
```

Raster Profile creations

```{r}
obs_years <- 2010:2024
crs_moll <- st_crs("ESRI:54009")$wkt

generate_weather_profiles <- function(stations_sf, target_crs, template, out_subdir) {
  dir.create(out_subdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  weather_stack <- list()
  for (year in obs_years) {
    message("Processing year: ", year)
    year_col <- as.character(year)
    
    # Filter for stations active this year
    weather_active <- stations_sf %>% filter(.data[[year_col]] == TRUE)
    
    # Transform points to the target projection
    weather_active <- st_transform(weather_active, target_crs)
    
    # Skip if no stations that year
    if (nrow(weather_active) == 0) {
      warning("No stations active in ", year)
      weather_stack[[year_col]] <- rast(template)
      next
    }
    
    # Rasterize station presence (counts per cell)
    weather_rast <- rasterize(vect(weather_active), template, field = NA, fun = "sum", background = 0)
    weather_stack[[year_col]] <- weather_rast
  }
  
  weather_stack <- rast(weather_stack)
  names(weather_stack) <- paste0("year_", obs_years)
  
  # Save each yearly raster
  for (i in 1:nlyr(weather_stack)) {
    writeRaster(weather_stack[[i]],
                file.path(out_subdir, paste0("weather_prof_", obs_years[i], ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  return(weather_stack)
}

#1 degree resolution templates
template_4326 <- rast(ext(-180, 180, -90, 90), resolution = 1, crs = "EPSG:4326")
template_moll <- project(template_4326, crs_moll, method = "near", res = 100000)


# RUN FOR BOTH PROJECTIONS

# Mollweide (used for area analysis)
generate_weather_profiles(weather_sts_moll_sf, crs_moll, template_moll, "GHCN_terr/profiles")

# EPSG:4326 (used for plotting)
generate_weather_profiles(weather_stations_sf , "EPSG:4326", template_4326, "GHCN_terr/profiles/esri4326")

```

```{r}
land_mask_sf <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "land", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")
land_mask_vect <- vect(land_mask_sf)

out_directory <- "GHCN_terr/coldspots/"
dir.create(out_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

process_ghcn_coldspots <- function(ghcn_dir, proj_name, out_prefix) {
  print(paste("Processing GHCN:", proj_name))
  
  # 1. Get files
  all_files <- list.files(ghcn_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
  years_to_keep <- as.character(2010:2024)
  ghcn_files <- all_files[grepl(paste(years_to_keep, collapse = "|"), all_files)]
  if(length(ghcn_files) == 0) stop("No .tif files found in the directory!")
  
  # 2. Read reference raster and align
  ref_rast <- rast(ghcn_files[1])
  ref_crs <- crs(ref_rast)
  
  aligned_rasters <- lapply(ghcn_files, function(f) {
    r <- rast(f)
    crs(r) <- ref_crs 
    if(!ext(r) == ext(ref_rast) || any(res(r) != res(ref_rast))) {
      r <- resample(r, ref_rast, method = "near") 
    }
    return(r)
  })
  
  ghcn_stack <- rast(aligned_rasters)
  
  # 3. Prepare Land Mask
  suppressWarnings({
    land_mask_proj <- project(land_mask_vect, crs(ghcn_stack))
  })
  land_mask_rast <- rasterize(land_mask_proj, ghcn_stack[[1]], field = 1)
  
  # 4. Calculate Cell Area
   if (is.lonlat(ghcn_stack)) {
    area_rast <- cellSize(ghcn_stack[[1]], unit = "km")
    print("Using cellSize (geographic CRS detected)")
   
   } else {
    res_xy <- res(ghcn_stack[[1]])
    cell_area_km2 <- (res_xy[1] * res_xy[2]) / 1e6
   area_rast <- rast(ghcn_stack[[1]])
    values(area_rast) <- cell_area_km2
    print(paste("Using planar method. Cell area (km2):", cell_area_km2))

   area_rast2 <- cellSize(ghcn_stack[[1]], unit = "km")

  }

  gap_area_list <- list()
  unsampled_list <- list() 
  
  # 5. Loop through years (EXACTLY matching your old logic)
  for (i in 1:nlyr(ghcn_stack)) {
    ghcn_rast <- ghcn_stack[[i]]
    ghcn_rast <- mask(ghcn_rast, land_mask_rast)
    
    # Classify: 0 counts -> 1 (Un-sampled), >0 counts -> NA
    unsamp_gap <- classify(ghcn_rast, matrix(c(-Inf, 0, 1, 0, Inf, NA), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE))
    
    unsampled_list[[i]] <- unsamp_gap
    
    # Calculate gap area
    gap_area_unsampled <- global(area_rast * (unsamp_gap == 1), sum, na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
   # gap_area_unsampled2 <- global(area_rast2 * (unsamp_gap == 1), sum, na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
    
    gap_area_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      class = "Un-sampled",
      year = 2010 + i - 1, 
      area_km2 = gap_area_unsampled
    )
  }
  
  # 6. Persistence
  unsampled_stack <- rast(unsampled_list)
  names(unsampled_stack) <- paste0("year_", 2010:2024)
  
  gap_persistence <- app(unsampled_stack, function(x) {
    sum(!is.na(x) & x > 0) / length(x)
  })
  gap_persistence <- mask(gap_persistence, land_mask_rast)
  writeRaster(gap_persistence, paste0(out_directory, out_prefix, "_gap_persist2.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  # 7. Coldspot Mask (>= 80%)
  coldspot_mask <- classify(gap_persistence, matrix(c(-Inf, 0.8, NA, 0.8, Inf, 1), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE), right = FALSE)
  
  
  coldspot_patches <- patches(coldspot_mask, directions = 4)
  coldspot_polygons <- as.polygons(coldspot_patches, dissolve = TRUE)
  coldspot_disaggregated <- terra::disagg(coldspot_polygons)
  
  cold_spot_sf <- st_as_sf(coldspot_disaggregated)
  cold_spot_sf$area_sf <- as.numeric(st_area(cold_spot_sf)) / 1e6 
  
  large_coldspots_sf <- cold_spot_sf %>% filter(area_sf > 200000)
  
  # 9. Rasterize back
  final_cold_spot_raster <- rasterize(vect(large_coldspots_sf), gap_persistence, field = 1)
 writeRaster(final_cold_spot_raster, paste0(out_directory, out_prefix, "_final_coldspot2.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  # 10. Area Calculations
  pre_filter_area <- sum(cold_spot_sf$area_sf)
  total_cold_area <- sum(large_coldspots_sf$area_sf)
  eliminated_area <- 1 - (total_cold_area / pre_filter_area)
  
  print(paste("Total Coldspot Area BEFORE filter (km2):", pre_filter_area))
  print(paste("Total Large Coldspot Area (km2):", total_cold_area))
  print(paste("Proportion of area eliminated by filter:", eliminated_area))
  
  # 11. Dataframe format
  gap_area_df <- bind_rows(gap_area_list) %>%
    mutate(
      area_10k_km2 = area_km2 / 1e4,
      projection = proj_name
    )
  
 write.csv(gap_area_df, paste0(out_directory, out_prefix, "_gap_area_df.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(gap_area_df)
}
```



Different projections

```{r}

df_moll <- process_ghcn_coldspots(
  ghcn_dir = "GHCN_terr/profiles",
  proj_name = "Mollweide", 
  out_prefix = "ws_moll"
)


df_4326 <- process_ghcn_coldspots(
  ghcn_dir =  "GHCN_terr/profiles/esri4326", 
  proj_name = "EPSG4326", 
  out_prefix = "ws_4326"
)
```
